cues.text: At 12:00 PM tomorrow, the sun will turn neon blue for ten minutes. If you look at it, you will lose your vision forever.
Scientists call it an extreme ultraviolet flare. It instantly strips the ozone layer, blasting the ground with lethal blue radiation.
Glass cannot block this wavelength. If you are near a window, you have exactly sixty seconds to cover every opening with foil and heavy blankets.
Step into the most central, windowless room of your home, and shut off all mirrors. Reflection amplifies the ultraviolet intensity tenfold.
At minute seven, every street light will shatter, and the sky will hum with a deafening frequency. Do not open the door.
Then, your phone buzzes with an unreleased NASA satellite alert: The sun never changed.
A colossal anomaly entered orbit and eclipsed the light. Which is why you must stay silent.
Timeline secured. Share this to warn someone before twelve o'clock tomorrow.
